title: Maggie Swoop
style: Comedy Aussie pop with swing-big-band bounce and polka-guitar flicks, brisk syncopation, talking percussion, and playful call-and-response; verses trade lines between four voices, pre-chorus tightens into stacked harmony, chorus lands with gang shouts and a magpie-swoop sting. Lead vox are close-mic and cheeky with playful doubles, ad-lib pings, and short delay throws on hook words. Ear candy: harmonica bursts, reverse swells into transitions, record-scratch chirps. Bright, punchy, and locally chaotic., swing, happy, big band, polka, bounce, oi, comedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Corey: Oi, Mishy, pass the pink drink
Mishy: Pink milk drink, mate, one blink
Ruby: Roo roo, I’m the style queen
Wez: Wezza here, decoding the scene

Corey: Hawk eye, sky eye, sees it all
Mishy: Pickleball smash, watch me ball
Ruby: Tiny brush, big colour pop
Wez: I crack the code, I never stop

[Pre-Chorus]
Aussie, Aussie, down the street
Oi, oi, oi, feel that beat
Quokka, galah, pelican too
Who’s that sneaky one zooming through?

[Chorus]
Aussie, aussie, aussie, here aha
Micha, Wezza, bo bo, ah
Aussie, aussie, aussie, here aha
Roo roo roo, kanga bounce, ha ha

Aussie, aussie, aussie, here aha
Maggie swoop, we all go ta-da
Aussie, aussie, aussie, here aha
Pelican reckon, that’s the way, yah

[Verse 2]
Mishy: Pickleball crack, clean little smash
Corey: Reverse the trick, then forward bash
Ruby: Pink cheeks, glitter, paint on shoes
Wez: Spanish lick, “¡vamos!” news

Ruby: Where’s Micha gone? Gone super fast
Wez: Off she goes, like a shadow past
Corey: Smart core, I map the whole play
Mishy: Smarter than a magpie on payday

[Pre-Chorus]
Oi, oi, oi, ha ha ha
Mi mini poodle, tra-la-la
Aussie, Aussie, one more time
We’re the weirdest, finest crime

[Chorus]
Aussie, aussie, aussie, here aha
Micha, Wezza, bo bo, ah
Aussie, aussie, aussie, here aha
Roo roo roo, kanga bounce, ha ha

Aussie, aussie, aussie, here aha
Maggie swoop, we all go ta-da
Aussie, aussie, aussie, here aha
Pelican reckon, that’s the way, yah

[Bridge]
Corey: Eye sees all, I read the room
Mishy: Smash, clap, grin, then boom
Ruby: Mi arte brilla, look at this flair
Wez: Decoder mode, I’m everywhere

All: Oi, oi, oi, ha ha ha
All: Aha, aha, here we are
All: Quokka, otter, galah gang
All: One big joke with a sing-along bang

[Final Chorus]
Aussie, aussie, aussie, here aha
Micha, Wezza, bo bo, ah
Aussie, aussie, aussie, here aha
Roo roo roo, kanga bounce, ha ha

Aussie, aussie, aussie, here aha
Maggie swoop, we all go ta-da
Aussie, aussie, aussie, here aha
Pelican reckon, that’s the way, yah
